title: A Space owner can invite a second Space to co-host a Journey, and that Space's admin accepts it

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), Journeys review of #3311 (LIVE-861).

detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: journey_plan_space_shares (20270346006100) has pending and accepted states and readers in lib/journey-plans.ts, but nothing in app, lib or components writes it. LIVE-861's own detail says the first share is written by SQL the owner runs and there is no owner UI to invite or accept a co-host, and no row tracked the follow-up, so the co-host Space's consent is not modelled in the product. THE FIX: an invite action for the Journey's Space admin and an accept action gated on the co-host Space's admin, mirroring event_space_shares.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!['app','lib','components'].some(d=>{const walk=(p)=>fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()?fs.readdirSync(p).some(x=>walk(p+'/'+x)):/\.tsx?$/.test(p)&&!/test|database\.types/.test(p)&&/journey_plan_space_shares['\u0022]\)\s*\.(insert|upsert|update)/.test(r(p));return walk(d)})){console.error('SCAN-840: nothing in the product writes a Journey co-host share');process.exit(1)}"
